commitResults.messageTitle: Expose a read-only live client feed
commitResults.messageBody:
The command list can be filtered or sorted for pending follow-ups, so it
cannot also supply the dashboard with every committed client.

Expose the existing unmodifiable address-book list through Logic. Keep
its stable identity, insertion order and canonical client references
without adding another collection or persistence path.

Assert settled selection membership and clean command publication. Add
regression tests for committed updates, same-name clients, filtering,
candidate isolation and failed saves that publish no data.

Leave projection wiring and main-guide updates to G2 and the reserved
I-G integration slot.

The feed tests do not independently verify that saved data exists when
observers receive a successful mutation. Their save-time comparison uses
snapshots from the same listener and cannot establish publication order.

Read saved data during observer notification and compare it with the
published feed. Also cover deletion through pending indices when two
clients share a name, preserving the other client's canonical selection.

Remove the redundant snapshot check without changing production
behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add a live pending follow-up projection
commitResults.messageBody:
The pending sidebar needs a complete read-only summary independent of
command-list filters and indices.

Derive a stable observable list from the supplied full feed, retaining
immutable client references and sorting by due date with source-order
ties. Detach its listener on close and retain the final snapshot.

Validate null programmer arguments explicitly and test ordering, same-
name identities, date partitions and unmodifiable output. Keep the
component independent of G1 and window composition.

The summary must track full-feed mutations while command filters and
pending-mode sorting leave global membership unchanged.

Cover action recording, date replacement, clearing, deletion, resets and
source permutations. Verify observer snapshots, stable list identity and
canonical records without depending on the unmerged G1 API.

Repeatedly opening and disposing summaries must not retain source
listeners or update closed views.

Verify listener attachment and detachment, idempotent close, frozen
snapshots and independent live projections using a tracking source list.
Keep guide drafts local for the reserved integration slot.

JavaFX can invoke a queued source callback after an earlier listener
closes the projection during the same notification. Detaching the
listener alone does not prevent this final rebuild.

Guard rebuilding with the closed state so the final snapshot remains
unchanged. Add a regression test that closes from an earlier source
listener and verifies that no output notification or replacement occurs.
